title: Remove the black gap between Home and the reading
acceptance: R2: the first word appears 1.5 s or less after the press, with a visual field on screen throughout.
Home's backdrop bakes are cancelled at launch; no Home long tasks during the reading.

evidence.note: Investigation of production 97ca014f: probe measurements, code references and the last 14 days of history.
Gallery entry gate of two flames, rest filled after entry; no flash-plate bakes before a Gallery opens.
Local: Begin to reading 3,213-3,541 ms on production (75 flames requested) and 1,730-2,356 ms on the branch dev build (2 flames). Today's poem on production: preload 0.9 s to 4.2 s after the press.

PR 7 of the canonical Home (b4-begin-hold): the router keeps Home shown under the Read view until the reading has faded in, and the factory raises no overlay and does not settle for a reading begun from Home. CI measures Begin to first word in e2e/home-begin.spec.js, now without test.fail().

activity.summary: Seeded from Phase A of the Consolidated Reader proposal; needs no owner decision.
Preparation gate fixed in #413; holding Home's field remains

PR 7 lands the hold (Home stays shown under the Read view until the reading has faded in) and the quiet factory (no overlay, no 300 ms settle for a reading begun from Home); CI's measurement is e2e/home-begin.spec.js, no longer an expected failure.

summary: A Gallery reading opens on two flames instead of its whole queue (and bakes no flash plates first), cutting the preparation screen from ~3.2-3.5 s to ~1.7-2.4 s on a dev build. R2 is not yet met: the preparation screen still shows briefly and Home's visuals do not stay on screen through it.
